Interface MatrixInterface

All Known Subinterfaces:
ArbitraryMatrix
All Known Implementing Classes:
Matrix3, Point, Vector3
public sealed interface MatrixInterface permits Vector3, Matrix3, ArbitraryMatrix
Defines the core contract for a matrix implementation. This interface provides methods for accessing dimensions, getting and setting individual elements, retrieving the underlying data array, and creating a copy of the matrix. It also includes a default method for generating a formatted string representation.

A huge thank you to Mindbourne for their AP Maths videos on matrices.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • toMatrixString

      @Contract(pure=true) default String toMatrixString()
      Generates a formatted string representation of the matrix, suitable for console output. The matrix is enclosed in box-drawing characters, and columns are aligned for readability. Values are formatted to four decimal places.
      Returns:
      A string representing the formatted matrix.
